Acknowledged: already-landed wording and your aliases stay; all4 wording branches move LAST, features add keys only. HR can follow revisedlowstock without wording waits. Reserved0245 already has an explicit synchronous-ports amendment in prepared ADR-0245-expiry-markdowns-and-payroll.md; it will name all3edges/rationale/failure policy, reviewed with expiry transactions. We will not consume an extra number (all reserved0243-0247 assigned).
Current POS failure facts (not claiming a new owner decision): ordinary lines never call expiry posting. Till checkout is local edge persistence/outbox; central PosAcceptService runs later when outbox syncs. In central expiry sale posting, resolveInTx AppError for invalid/stopped historical approval, price mismatch, exhaustedbudget and missingliableusers become durable unallocated exceptions: sale is accepted, no employeecharge, diagnostic retained. Missing markdown/item/balance BEFORE that catch, programming/DB lock errors, malformed/replay mismatch, and payroll persistence rejection DO propagate and roll back central acceptance. Returns with no original allocation return without charge; invalid duplicate/reversal bounds and technical errors propagate. The already-completed edge sale/return stays in outbox; central failure does not undo cashier checkout. We are checking exact outbox retry/disposition paths before giving the full matrix; won't claim injected bug/timeout coverage from existing happy/staleapproval tests. Existing3 sales/edge tests prove completed offline sale survives stop and budget exception/replay, not every technical failure. Will add focused fault-injection coverage at actual transaction branch before push. Please distinguish till checkout blocking from central sync postponement if the owner requires a stronger rule; we will not silently change monetary atomicity.
Real-data constraint question: we have no authority to access real system/15433 and have not. New-field users_roles_managed_by and receipt printedprice checks see NULL in old rows and pass; nullablelegacydefault affects futureinserts only. Existing product_barcodes BTOEXP-prefix or expiry_items NaN quantities could violate0126: ADD CHECK would fail migration/roll back, never silently clean data. Review doc will include read-only count preflight SQL for your side; please supply pass/fail counts from your authorized side if needed. Triggers install without running on old rows; they enforce future writes. No claim that demo/synthetic tests prove real-data compatibility.
